crossRefs.note: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.
So Job died, being old and full of days.
but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.
Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

translations.web: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
translations.bsb: You will come to the grave in full vigor, like a sheaf of grain gathered in season.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
translations.asv: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, Like as a shock of grain cometh in in its season.
